== Opening Blessing ==
We may be the only intelligent life in our galaxy. This may even be likely. In this less vibrant outlook lie threads of optimism. May we take this responsibility seriously. May we find hope in the idea that the Great Filter lies in our past. May we do work in service to that Cosmos from which we spring.
--Blessed Be

== Closing Blessing ==
It may be debatable whether there is intelligent life in our Galaxy, us included.  But if we are the best representatives of Life, then let us take that responsibility seriously.  We came together, focused on the direction of our efforts.  May we find that we pushed in the right direction.  And may we continue to push in the right direction.
-- Blessed Be
